aiDisabledBody: Turn it on to ask questions about your hisab. Answers are calculated on this phone.
aiDraftNote: Nothing is saved until you check and save it.
aiOnlineFailed: Online AI is unavailable, so this answer was written on your phone.
aiExample1: How much did I spend this month?
aiExample2: What is my biggest expense category?
aiExample3: Compare this month with last month
aiExample5: How much do people owe me?
aiExample6: How can I reduce my expenses?
aiHelp: I can answer questions about your own records, for example: spending or income in a period, your biggest category, top expenses, how much a person owes you, what a group trip cost, or who owes whom in a group. Try one of the suggestions below.
aiSavings: In {period} you earned {income} and spent {expense}, so you saved {savings}.
aiTopCategory: Your biggest expense category in {period} was {category}: {amount} ({percent}% of spending).
aiNoExpenses: There are no expenses recorded in {period}.
aiPersonOwesYou: {name} owes you {amount} in total (all open khata entries).
aiYouOwePerson: You owe {name} {amount} in total (all open khata entries).
aiPersonSettled: You and {name} are all settled — nothing is pending.
aiGroupTotal: {group} has cost {amount} so far across {count} expenses. Your share is {share}.
aiReceivables: People owe you {receivable} and you owe others {payable} (all open khata entries).
aiTipsIntro: Based on {period}, a few ideas (suggestions, not facts):
aiTipCategory: {category} took {percent}% of your spending ({amount}). Setting a monthly limit for it would have the biggest effect.
aiTipFrequent: You made {count} small expenses under ₹200 — together {amount}. Small daily spends add up.
aiTipSavings: You spent more than you earned this period. Reviewing the top categories first usually helps most.
aiTipGeneral: Record every expense for a month, then compare months here to see what changed.
aiDraftExpense: I prepared an expense of {amount}{category}. Please review it before saving.
aiDraftIncome: I prepared an income entry of {amount}{category}. Please review it before saving.
aiDraftNeedsAmount: Tell me the amount too, for example: “add expense 250 for groceries”. I will not guess amounts.
aiNoPerson: I could not find that person in your khata.
aiNoGroup: I could not find that group.
aiApiKeyNote: The key is stored encrypted on this phone and is used only for online answers. Online usage is billed to your Anthropic account.
